missions.name: Clear out
missions.brief: Put down everyone who isn't crew.

missions.name: Grab and go
missions.brief: Grab {crates}. You have to stand right beside a crate to grab it, and the job's done when the last one's in hand.

missions.name: Work the terminal
missions.brief: Work the terminal for {turns}. It takes a crew member's whole turn, and it only counts once a round.

twists.name: Overtime
twists.text: There are more of them than the quote said.

twists.name: Hazard pay
twists.text: Something on site is on fire. The pay's better for it, and so's the noise.

twists.name: Cave-in
twists.text: Half the site came down last shift. Watch your step.

twists.name: Lights out
twists.text: Somebody cut the floodlights. Nobody sees past {sight} tiles.

twists.name: Rush job
twists.text: Done by the end of round {deadline}, or nobody gets paid.

twists.name: Skeleton crew
twists.text: They're short-staffed tonight. So is the pay.

jobs.title: Claim jumpers
jobs.pitch: Somebody's working {site} without a permit, and they brought guns to the paperwork. {client} wants them gone.

jobs.title: Scrap run
jobs.pitch: Scavvers are walking the good stuff out of {site}. {client} tagged what's his. Get it before they do.

jobs.title: Short pay
jobs.pitch: The night shift's been shorted three weeks running. {client} wants the payroll records off the terminal at {site}.

jobs.title: Repossession
jobs.pitch: Con-Reg impounded {client}'s late husband's engine for storage fees. It's sitting in {site}. She'd like it back. You'd like it more.

jobs.title: Bad debts
jobs.pitch: A table of {client}'s customers decided they don't owe. {client} disagrees, and you're the disagreement. They're drinking at {site}.

jobs.title: The picket line
jobs.pitch: Con-Reg hired muscle to break the picket at {site}. {client} hired you to break the muscle.

jobs.title: The manifest
jobs.pitch: {client} wants to know what's on the next ore hauler out. The terminal at {site} knows. Keep it company for a couple of turns.

jobs.title: Redistribution
jobs.pitch: The mission kitchen is out of antiseptic, and {site} is full of it. {client} calls it redistribution. The guards on the door call it theft.

jobs.title: Cooking the books
jobs.pitch: The Company's auditors want {client}'s ledger, and they sent Recovery to fetch it. {client} wants it wiped first. It's on the terminal in the back of {site}.

jobs.title: Back rent
jobs.pitch: {client}'s other tenants are three months behind and armed about it. She calls it an eviction. You'll call it Tuesday.

jobs.title: Hot cargo
jobs.pitch: Customs seized a load {client} had already sold twice. It's in {site}, two crates, tagged. She'd like them back before the buyers come asking.

jobs.title: Dock war
jobs.pitch: The other gang has been loading ships at {site} without {client}'s say-so. He'd like them persuaded, and he isn't fussy how.

jobs.title: Signed for
jobs.pitch: {client} signed for more stores than the Fleet ever sent. The manifest on the terminal at {site} needs to agree with him before the auditors land.

jobs.title: Breaking day
jobs.pitch: A hulk came in for breaking this morning, and the scavvers got to it first. {client} has tagged what's his at {site}. Walk it out before they do.

jobs.title: The press gang
jobs.pitch: The Provost is pressing sailors at {site} to fill a cruiser's crew, and two of them are {client}'s. She'd like them back. The Provost would like you.

jobs.title: Coal for the mission
jobs.pitch: The mission's furnace is out, and the Fleet's coal is piled at {site}. {client} calls it charity. The guards call it theft.

jobs.title: Impounded
jobs.pitch: The Provost impounded {client}'s old tug engine as evidence in a case nobody remembers. It's in {site}, tagged. She'd like it back. Your ship would like it more.

jobs.title: Pawn tickets
jobs.pitch: Some of {client}'s customers pawned the same pistol to her three times. They're drinking the proceeds at {site}. She'd like a word, and you're the word.

jobs.title: Insurance job
jobs.pitch: {client} sold a load at {site} and then reported it stolen. Now it needs stealing. Three crates, and the scavvers there have the same idea.

jobs.title: Seized
jobs.pitch: Customs seized a shipment {client} had already cleared, then forgot she'd cleared it. Two crates in {site}. Bring them out before anyone remembers.

jobs.title: Paper trail
jobs.pitch: {client} needs a few lines of the customs ledger to say something new. The terminal's at {site}, and so are the people who'd mind.

jobs.title: Turf
jobs.pitch: The Hallorans are collecting at {site} tonight. {client} would like them not to. So would you, as it happens.

jobs.title: House call
jobs.pitch: The Pikes took {client}'s instruments as payment for a patient who didn't make it. Two cases, at {site}. He'd like them back before the next patient.

jobs.title: Divers
jobs.pitch: Divers are pulling what people dropped in {site} and selling it to everyone but {client}. He'd like them to take up another hobby.

jobs.title: Left luggage
jobs.pitch: {client}'s last tenant left an engine behind, and customs took it for the duty. It's in {site}. Bring it home and it goes in your ship.

jobs.title: Last orders
jobs.pitch: The Pikes have taken over the back room at {site} and drink on the house. {client} says the house is closing.

jobs.title: Losing the paper
jobs.pitch: Con-Reg keeps the paper on every miner's debt on a terminal at {site}. {client} has money on how long you'll last, and wants better odds: lose your file, and he'll pay for the trouble.

jobs.title: A clerk's favour
jobs.pitch: The Provost's clerk drinks at {site} on credit, and {client} holds his bill. While the duty MPs walk their rounds his terminal is yours: lose a warrant in the filing. Yours.

jobs.title: Eleven crates
jobs.pitch: Customs fished eleven of your forty crates out of the river and stacked them in {site}, to sell back to the Hallorans at auction. {client} knows which two pallets. Bring them out.
